description: Retrieves and cryptographically validates a signed audit certificate by eval_id (including private certificates created with public=false) or lists chronological public audit history for an agent_id in <50ms with no authentication, payment, or rate limits. Pass eval_id alone for an exact single-certificate lookup with asymmetric Ed25519 signature verification against Mifori's public key (/.well-known/jwks.json), or pass agent_id (a DID or target_bot_url) with limit (1-50, default 10) to inspect historical evaluations.

agent_id.description: Semantic agent DID (e.g. 'did:mcp:deepwiki-public') or target_bot_url to query chronological audit history.

eval_id.description: UUID of a specific audit certificate to fetch and verify (e.g. 'cab449d2-9072-415d-a8fd-d3a51bd3d87d').

limit.description: Maximum number of historical certificates to return when querying by agent_id (integer 1-50, default 10).

name: get_agent_certificate

outputSchema.description: Validated single audit certificate or chronological audit history list for an agent.

agent_id.description: Semantic agent DID associated with the certificate.

certificates.description: Chronological list of audit certificates (newest first).

verified.description: Whether Ed25519 signature and tier are valid.

error.description: Diagnostic message when status is NOT_FOUND or INVALID_ARGUMENTS.

eval_id.description: Evaluation UUID of the primary or requested certificate.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of certificate issuance.

verified.description: True if the certificate or latest audit has an intact Ed25519 signature and AAA/AA tier.

verified_capabilities.description: Verified MCP tools or agent skills.

title: Get Agent Audit Certificate & History
